newsitem.title: USA: Dow drops more than 50 points.
newsitem.headline: Dow drops more than 50 points.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average lost more than 50 points in late morning trading Monday, weighed down by profit-taking after Friday's record close.
At 11:30 a.m. EDT, the index of 30 blue-chip issues was off 50.66 points at 7,745.85, which activated the New York Stock Exchange's limits on program trading.
